title: TRICARE Prime First Installment: Months Owed and the Supplement Amount
content:
**Billing operations note.** A first installment of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment owes the months from the month containing the enrollment effective date to the end of the installment period containing that date, installment periods being calendar months for a monthly arrangement, calendar quarters for a quarterly one and the calendar year for an annual one; the month containing the effective date counts at the monthly rate times the lesser of 30 and its days from the effective date through the last day of the coverage period of the installment charge beginning on the effective date, 30 where no such charge stands, over 30, every later month owed at the monthly rate, TRICARE Select coverage takes nothing off, and the installment charges posted on the application date count against it. The annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement is the tier's annual individual fee for an individual arrangement and its annual family fee for a family arrangement.

## Terms

- **Monthly rate.** One twelfth of the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (the annual fee divided by 12), rounded to the cent. A plan year has 4 calendar quarters: January to March, April to June, July to September and October to December.
- **The first installment** is the month containing the effective date at its value and every later month it owes at the monthly rate, rounded to the cent.
- **The supplement** is the first installment so figured less the charges that count against it, never below zero, rounded to the cent.
- **The supplement's coverage period** runs from the first day of the first month the first installment owes that no counted charge covers to the last day of the last such month; it carries the installment frequency of the enrollment's payment arrangement and falls due on the day it is posted.
- Months are calendar months, numbered continuously from January 2000.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A, individual arrangement (annual fee 390.12, monthly rate 32.51), quarterly installments; effective date 1 April.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Months owed | April, May, June (to the end of the April-June quarter) |
| April: the charge beginning 1 April covers through 30 April, 30 days; 32.51 times 30 over 30 | 32.51 |
| May and June at the monthly rate | 65.02 |
| First installment | 97.53 |
| Charges posted on the application date | one charge of 32.51 covering April |
| Supplement: 97.53 less 32.51 | 65.02, coverage period 1 May to 30 June |

Where the charges posted on the application date already total 97.53 or more, the supplement is 0.00.
